dialect: MEF LSO Sonata (REST/JSON product ordering, buyer–seller)
note: Lifted semantic model, MEF LSO Sonata (product ordering) side. A REST/OpenAPI interface: the payload field names are present but their meaning is implicit in the MEF standard and the inter-carrier operational context. Sonata is the BUYER/SELLER product-ordering interface between two carriers; it orders commercial connectivity PRODUCTS, distinct from the technical service that realises them. A live side volunteers gloss/example; an inert side exposes only label, kind, relations, and instances, so its meaning must be reconstructed from the REST surface with no shared standard to lean on.

concepts.label: productOrder
concepts.gloss: the inter-carrier product order a Buyer places to a Seller for connectivity products; the commercial order envelope exchanged across the carrier-to-carrier seam
concepts.example: PO-88, buyer=AcmeCarrier seller=NetCo, one EVPL between two UNIs

concepts.label: orderItem
concepts.gloss: one line of the product order carrying an action (add/modify/delete) on a single ordered product

concepts.label: product
concepts.gloss: the sellable connectivity product the buyer orders from the seller — a Carrier Ethernet virtual line (EVPL); the COMMERCIAL construct, distinct from the technical service that realises it
concepts.example: an EVPL product ordered between UNI-NY and UNI-FRA

concepts.label: productConfiguration
concepts.gloss: the MEF product configuration — the requested technical parameters of the ordered product: UNI reference, bandwidth profile (CIR/EIR) and class of service, carried in the product order as the buyer's ask
concepts.example: CIR 100 Mbps, class of service 'Gold', UNI 10GbE

concepts.label: relatedPlace
concepts.gloss: the geographic site — the UNI demarcation location — at which the ordered product is to be delivered
concepts.example: UNI at 350 E St, New York

concepts.label: state
concepts.gloss: the lifecycle state of the PRODUCT order/item in the buyer–seller COMMERCIAL process; tracks commercial fulfilment to the buyer, not technical activation in a network
concepts.example: state=inProgress (enum: acknowledged, rejected, pending, held, inProgress, completed, failed, cancelled)

concepts.label: itemTerm
concepts.gloss: the contractual term of the product order item — duration and commitment (e.g. 24 months); a purely commercial attribute with no technical realisation
